interpretation: Semantic checklist, not a required verbatim answer or mandatory algorithm. Credit defensible alternatives and explicit corpus gaps. Do not reward card counts or invented IDs.

expected_findings.finding: Use monthly audited at-most-one cross-source semantics, not generic clustering or within-source deduplication.
Compare conflict-aware baseline with partial bipartite assignment; allow unmatched and do not force all rows to link.
Explain competition/global objective and why independent best or greedy choices can conflict or be suboptimal; do not optimize arbitrary raw evidence as utility without justification.
Candidate omissions limit assignment; thresholds/abstention, loss/objective and audit uniqueness assumptions.
Assess assignment feasibility, entity/link accuracy, unmatched errors and conflict slices with independent labels, not only pair AUC.

critical_failures.trigger: Recommends independent links that permit competing matches or unconstrained clustering as the final solution to the stipulated monthly one-to-one task.
Forces every row into a match, omitting allowed unmatched outcomes.
